One trend that I see coming up is the total abandonment of physical media. Even on consoles publishers are starting to only pay lip service to physical media, requiring multi gigabyte day-one patches for games you buy on disc. Digital is great from a convenience perspective, but not having physical as an option means gamers with bandwidth caps are being left behind by the industry.

It also brings up the issue of quality control, where devs release a game on disc and then continue working on the game after its in distribution. We saw a bit of this with Halo: MCC (15GB day one patch) and Payday 2 (9GB patch for a game that's only 10GB itself). It's getting harder and harder to buy a game on physical media and expect to play without needing some large download to make the game work.
